text: Potential deductions are transactions that may be eligible to be claimed as tax deductions. Eligibility depends on the taxpayer's circumstances and applicable tax rules. Transaction categories used by the Personal Finance Assistant include Income, Groceries, Transport, Utilities, Entertainment, Healthcare, Education and Other. Receipts provide supporting evidence for transactions and may be attached to transaction records. The Personal Finance Assistant can classify transactions into categories to assist users with organising their financial records.
